input.question: Why it is so hard to remember our dreams ?
input.ground_truth: because they're considered irrelevant by our brains. you can train yourself in recollection. that's done mostly by writing down any shreds you do remember, as quickly as you can after you've had the dream.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Why it is so hard to remember our dreams ?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine your brain is like a little box where you put your toys (which are your memories). When you sleep, your brain plays with lots of fun pictures, like a movie—those are your dreams!

But when you wake up, your brain says, “Time to get ready for the day!” and it closes the box really tight. Because it closes the box quickly, some of the dream toys fall out or get hidden, so you can’t find them when you try to remember.

That’s why it’s so hard to remember your dreams when you wake up!
